chapters.label: Live: the 2025 semi-final
chapters.text: Champions League semi final, 2025. Sporting against Palma. In the first minute, Merlim tests Luan Muller, then Tomás Paçó. Luan stops them both!

chapters.label: The last minute
chapters.text: Palma lead two nil. Sporting attack with an extra player. In the last minute, the goalkeeper scores too! Three nil, and Palma reach the final.

chapters.label: How he does it (demo)
chapters.text: Watch how he does it. The shot is close, no time to dive. He stays square: chest to the ball, arms and legs wide. It hits his body!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Stay square to the ball, so shots hit your body.
